name: Deuz-SDK
description: TypeScript AI SDK and agent framework with zero dependencies. Build production AI agents and multi-agent swarms: durable execution, long-term memory, hybrid RAG, MCP client/server, A2A, human-in-the-loop approvals, CodeAct sandboxes, realtime voice. One streaming API, 29 providers: Claude, GPT, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Ollama. Node, Bun, Deno, edge.

highlights: Harness runner (preview) — runHarness runs Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode or Gemini CLI as a sub-agent, applies your policy to the permission requests the harness sends, and reports the cost…
Meter — a local proxy that charges the model requests of Claude Code, Codex or any Anthropic or OpenAI client to a budget, and refuses them with 402 at the ceiling.
AI SDK provider — wraps a Vercel AI SDK 7 model in one line, so existing AI SDK code runs under a Deuz budget.
MCP ledger — npx -y @deuz-sdk/mcp-ledger starts it for any MCP client.
